description_en: Call DescribeUsersWithPermissions to retrieve the IDs of all Resource Access Management (RAM) users or RAM roles that have Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) permissions
description_zh: 调用DescribeUsersWithPermissions获取所有具有RBAC权限的RAM用户或RAM角色ID
name: DescribeUsersWithPermissions

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to list the IDs of RAM users or RAM roles. Valid values:

`SubUser`: Lists the IDs of RAM users.

`RamRole`: Lists the IDs of RAM roles
parameters.help_zh:
选择列出RAM用户还是RAM角色的ID，取值：

`SubUser`：列出RAM用户ID

`RamRole`：列出RAM角色ID
parameters.name: user_type

UIDs.description_en: A list of IDs for the RAM users or RAM roles that currently have RBAC permissions
UIDs.description_zh: 当前具有RBAC权限的RAM用户或RAM角色ID列表

items.description_en: The ID of a RAM user or RAM role that currently has RBAC permissions
items.description_zh: 当前具有RBAC权限的RAM用户或RAM角色ID
